summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from GitHub releases (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...`) into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses `execFileSync` to invoke it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line bundle with hex-mangled identifiers, a shuffled string/opcode array, and a rotating decode routine (`WV8StW` performs `arr.push(arr.shift())`-style rotation over a large constant array of ints and strings). The package is published as a React responsive-components library, which has no functional need to ship or run an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or to execute an obfuscated bundle. The delivery chain — fetching a second runtime specifically to invoke an opaque bundled payload during `npm install` — fires automatically on default install and evades Node-based lifecycle inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
